"""One-use loopback redirect to the marked disposable lab's private login URL."""
import asyncio
import json
import sys
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from aiohttp import web
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/andy/.codex/worktrees/parallel-delivery/sandbox-crypto/.agents/labs')
from kernel_gui import PRIVATE, bounded, guard
HEAD = '70f6761a0e9d58b4ad54dc3338812befd21b99d5'
async def main():
    guard(HEAD)
    info = json.loads(bounded(PRIVATE, 4096))
    assert info['source_head'] == HEAD
    url = urlsplit(info['login_url'])
    assert url.scheme == 'http' and url.hostname == '127.0.0.1' and url.port == 38787
    assert url.path == '/login' and url.query.startswith('token=') and not url.fragment
    stopped = asyncio.Event()
    used = False
    port = None
    async def login(request):
        nonlocal used
        if used or request.query_string or request.can_read_body or request.host != f'127.0.0.1:{port}':
            raise web.HTTPNotFound()
        used = True
        asyncio.get_running_loop().call_later(2, stopped.set)
        raise web.HTTPSeeOther(location=info['login_url'], headers={'Cache-Control':'no-store'})
    app = web.Application()
    app.router.add_get('/lab27-browser-login', login)
    runner = web.AppRunner(app, access_log=None)
    try:
        await runner.setup()
        await web.TCPSite(runner, '127.0.0.1', 0).start()
        port = runner.addresses[0][1]
        print(json.dumps({'bridge_port':port, 'one_use':True, 'expires_seconds':45}), flush=True)
        async with asyncio.timeout(45):
            await stopped.wait()
        assert used
    finally:
        await runner.cleanup()
        print('PASS browser login bridge removed', flush=True)
asyncio.run(main())
